description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing within a system labeled “FedHLM”. The chart contains three slices representing different routing methods. The largest slice, colored green, is labeled “LOCAL” and occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. A red slice labeled “LLM” represents approximately 3.9% of the chart, and a blue slice labeled “EDGE_P2P” represents approximately 1.6%. Percentage labels are displayed inside the “LLM” and “EDGE_P2P” slices. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding routing method. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice (“LOCAL”) positioned at the bottom and the remaining slices arranged in descending order of size.
